Since /u/boxx's thread on user profile customization/personalization was very well recieved, I want to offer some inspiration for what the whoaverse user profile might look like in the future.

Here is an example of a Hubski's user profile (random person)

There's a small little area where users seem to be given a space to write a little about themselves. Maybe we do the same with a character limit of sorts? They also have an avatar. It looks a bit bulky though. Maybe something smaller if we want to go for an avatar (without showing them in the comments, just the profile), there's a stats section, and there's a tags section which we can also adopt if we ever go with the tags system in the future.

Slightly Off Topic

There's something unique to hubski too in that users have the ability to share submissions and comments that they like with each other (this is what it appears like, I haven't registered). This seems like a cool feature that we could adopt as well. With that, you could see how well a submission or comment was recieved by looking at number of shares in addition to upvote/downvote ratio. Such a feature syngergizes with the whole idea that people are interested in knowing what others think, having sentiment gauges, etc. It didn't hit me that people are interested in knowing what others think about something and how integral it had become to the reddit user experience until the flood of complaints in the notorious announcement thread. Redditors themselves probably didn't even realize how important this had become to their user experience until it suddenly got taken away from them. This is something that could build on that.

Back on Topic

There's this cool little time series graph they have there, but that's just a little thing that looks cool. Don't know if anyone else likes it.

Oh yeah, hubski's visual design is very ugly. I'm glad that whoaverse's graphic designer or Atko has a better eye than that.
